method.candidate_path_rule: regular Git blobs under */cards/*.kt; strip .kt and trailing Reprint; lowercase and remove non-alphanumeric characters; compare against the same normalization of each missing card identity

interpretation: No one of the 51 current-runtime missing identities has an exact normalized canonical */cards/*.kt definition basename in this main tree under the stated path rule. Therefore no registry-only batch is established by filename evidence.
limits: This is a path/static diagnostic, not proof that no indirect alias, differently named implementation, generated source, or reusable primitive exists.
It grants no mechanics competence, registry presence, pilot competence, Position-1 execution admission, seed authority or gameplay.
Split/adventure/transform identities require explicit source inspection rather than inference from this filename rule.
next_gate: Use historical requirement coverage to choose the smallest high-reuse missing identity batch, inspect any reusable mechanics explicitly, then implement and qualify card definitions/registration with deterministic mechanics tests before relying on registry presence.
